allow: PowerShell($routes = @\('/', '/projects', '/projects/public', '/projects/private', '/projects/solidarity', '/projects/arena', '/projects/assignment', '/projects/new'\); foreach \($r in $routes\) { try { $resp = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:5181$r" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 5; "{0,-26} {1}  {2} bytes" -f $r, $resp.StatusCode, $resp.RawContent.Length } catch { "{0,-26} ERR  {1}" -f $r, $_.Exception.Message } })
